scope.summary: Cross-backend parity (driver-cx vs official) for DATE/TIMESTAMP/TSLTZ/INTERVAL/CLOB/BLOB/NULL on FREE 23ai: every fixture cell serializes identically against independent expected values; planted UTC suffix / empty-string NULL fail the shared parity assertion.
